{{Quote|We captured a Rebel Jedi and Vader wants to question him personally. This is a huge opportunity for us all. And on Empire Day of all days!|An Imperial commander speaking of an [[Jedi Prisoner|imprisoned Jedi]]|<ref name="SWG:HED" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''commander''' in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Imperial commander was stationed in [[Outpost GRF-7493]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:HED" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, he met an Imperial spacer, sent to meet him from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by an [[Unidentified Imperial data officer|Imperial data officer]]. The commander had the spacer speak to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Vader]], so that he could complete the important mission. The Imperial handed Darth Vader some historical documents regarding the [[Jedi Prisoner|Jedi they had imprisoned]] After speaking for a short time, Lord Vader had the Imperial report back to the Imperial commander, who awarded him with an Imperial banner. The Imperial commander had one final task for the soldier, which involved interrogating the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] they had imprisoned for information. Fortunately, the interrogation was successful, and so they gained the information they were looking for. Following Empire Day, the commander left the facility to pursue other matters.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Did you speak to him? He's an inspiration, that's for sure. I'm hoping some day to serve aboard his flagship.|An Imperial commander speaking fondly of Darth Vader|<ref name="SWG:HED" />}}
The Imperial commander was enthusiastically loyal toward Lord Vader, and the Empire he served. He had aspirations to serve aboard Darth Vader's flagship, the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].

==Behind the scenes==
An Imperial commander, who lacked an official name, appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial commander was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> he could be found at an outpost on Yavin 4 and was part of a quest titled, "[[W:c:swg:Happy Empire Day!|Happy Empire Day!]]," which sent players on an important mission throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:HED" /> After the live event ended, the Imperial commander never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
